subject.title: feat(mattermost): auto-engage on replies to the bot's own thread

question: Should Mattermost bot-authored thread roots bypass `requireMention` and `onchar` by default, with no new operator config?
rationale: The patch is a clean Mattermost-local implementation, but it changes when existing rooms receive agent replies; automation should not choose that delivery policy for maintainers.

options.title: Accept Default-On Root Replies
options.body: Mattermost will match sibling reply-to-bot behavior, and maintainers own the compatibility impact for rooms that relied on mention-only gating.

options.title: Require Live Roundtrip First
options.body: Hold merge until someone captures a real Mattermost thread reply to a bot-authored root that triggers without an @mention.

options.title: Narrow Or Opt In
options.body: Pause this PR and require an explicit config or stricter policy before changing default reply delivery.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-On Root Replies
recommendation.body: Mattermost will match sibling reply-to-bot behavior, and maintainers own the compatibility impact for rooms that relied on mention-only gating.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows broad ownership of Mattermost monitor/gating/docs refactors and this is a default behavior decision across channel delivery semantics.
